From: Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@acme-platform.com>

Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — marketplace listing & reseller plan

Diego,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier today. Per our conversation, Procurement asked that we put a short mutual action plan together that highlights the specific marketplace / reseller steps and an expected close timeline so they can line up internal approvals. We also want to make sure the reseller (CloudResell LLC) is looped in for commercial/contract routing.

Could you share a concise MAP we can commit to this week? Top asks from Acme:
- Confirm which marketplace SKUs we will publish first (AWS and Azure priority, GCP optional)
- Provide estimated lead times for marketplace onboarding checks (SaaS entitlement + billing)
- Share reseller flow for invoicing (will Ledger go through CloudResell or directly to Acme?)

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Tina

Tina Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Platform
Attachments: none

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Tina Lopez <tina.lopez@acme-platform.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-27T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — marketplace listing & reseller plan

Tina —

Thanks. I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_Acme_Redwood_v1.xlsx) and a short procurement checklist for your team. High level summary below and proposed owners. If this looks good we can lock the dates and set a weekly 30-min checkpoint (Thursdays 10:00 PT) for status updates.

Summary (proposed):
- Week 1 (7/27–8/2): Confirm SKUs and packaging for AWS + Azure; provide sample SaaS SSO and billing metadata. Owner: Marissa Cole (Product GTM).
- Week 2 (8/3–8/9): Marketplace onboarding submission (AWS + Azure) + reseller billing flow defined. Owner: Priyom Das (Commercial Ops).
- Week 3 (8/10–8/16): Vendor verification, test entitlements, and end-to-end billing smoke test (CloudResell if applicable). Owner: Acme + CloudResell ops.
- Week 4 (8/17–8/23): Contract routing & DocuSign + final go/no-go. Owner: Acme Procurement + Redwood Legal.

Reseller notes:
- We can support both direct invoices to Acme and reseller-mediated invoicing. For reseller flow the standard approach is: Redwood invoices CloudResell -> CloudResell issues invoice to Acme. We will provide a reseller matrix (.csv) with tax and remit details for reconciliation.

Marketplace lead times (estimates):
- AWS SaaS: 5–9 business days after submission (depends on account verification).
- Azure Marketplace: 7–12 business days (validation + metering setup).
- GCP Marketplace: 10–15 business days (optional, recommend after initial launch).

Next steps / open asks for Acme:
1) Confirm preferred SKUs for initial launch (list in attached MAP tab "SKUs").
2) Confirm whether CloudResell will handle invoicing or Acme prefers direct billing.
3) Share primary procurement contact for DocuSign routing.

I’ll schedule the weekly checkpoint for Thu 8/6 10:00 PT unless you prefer an earlier cadence.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0122
Attachments: MAP_Acme_Redwood_v1.xlsx, procurement_checklist_acme.pdf
